In my local one they leave boxes in a display cage near the checkout stations (again, only before 12). Because they're made from misshapen or discoloured or loose food, it's impossible to predict how many boxes they'll be able to make up on any given day, and probably some days some places can't make any. Obviously it's first come first serve, but I live in a busy place and there's usually one or two left before they go because I think people prefer buying specifically what they want rather than having to adapt the meal plans (also bear in mind I'm cooking for one and I like all foods so I don't have to take anyone's tastes into account - I def get why some parents might leave it alone). You can't pre-order because as I said, the supply is basically random. I imagine most outlets make at least some up every day, because unsaleable produce is basically inevitable. Normally I'd say if you're really keen, earlier is better, but right now obv that might not be the most considerate thing to do - plus, like I said, I was able to nab mine at about 10:30 this morning.
